item.title: Tone Master Deluxe Reverb
item.author: invalid@example.com (hippietim)
item.dc:creator: hippietim
item.content:encoded:
How come nobody told me these were really cool?

I stopped at GC to checkout some other gear and was bored so I checked out a used Deluxe. Dude even hooked up a Klon clone for me to try it with a drive pedal. I thought it sounded really good and worked great with the pedal. The reverb sounds like a spring reverb and the tremolo is good. They had a Twin as well and it was cool too.

These Tone Master amps are legit!

item.content:encoded:
When cleaning up my desk I realized I had a lot more Jazz III picks than I thought and suddenly the inner guitar nerd in me whispered "....but do they sound different?"



I opened Logic and grabbed a Strat then just played the same lick over and over again with each pick. Yes, they sound different. As soon as I was done I felt dirty; I had just slipped into an area I frequently speak down upon- minute tonal differences that don't f*cking matter. That said, it's really interesting...
